Achim Oldenburg was an early Tesla enthusiast. But his car crashed into a tree on a straight country road; the car burst into flames. He did not survive. For years, experts like Missy Cummings, a former Navy fighter pilot and robotics researcher, have been warning about the risks of this unfinished autonomous driving technology. The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) and other institutions are beginning to investigate Tesla's Autopilot system.
